svg.title: How far each blind playtester got in Planetfall
svg.desc: Best score out of 80 for each of the 33 blind playtest runs across nineteen rounds, marking wins and checkpoint starts; and, for round 12, each tester's score against commands played, life by life, with deaths marked. The numbers are in playtest-scores.json.
svg.text: How far each blind playtester got
Points scored out of Planetfall's 80, read from the session transcripts. Nineteen rounds of blind AI testers, 10 to 23 September 2026.
points handed over by a mid-game checkpoint
Every tester, round by round: best score
Rounds 1 to 8 were one sitting of about 200 to 400 commands; rounds 10 to 12 began at the start and ran 941 to 1,489 in legs.

g.text: Checkpoint starts: the Tower Core hands over 21 points, the Lawanda Platform 42. A white tick marks a final score below the best.
Rounds 13 to 20 had one tester each: six click-only (15 and 18 from the Lawanda checkpoint) and two typed; 17 to 20 played personas.
Round 12, from the start to the end: every life
Score against commands sent to the game. After each death the tester restored a save, or started again from the beginning (the line drops to 0),
and went on knowing what had killed it. A dashed line is a new agent taking the session over with the diary so far as its only memory.

text.tspan: won 74 of 80 at turn 692, after 1,489 commands, 4 starts from the beginning and 26 deaths

eaten in the night; no save, so from the start
22 deaths at 69, each restored: 21 to the
Bio Lab mutants, 1 to hunger. It mapped
the way out of Lawanda by dying in it
